name: Data Science
description: Turning raw data into answers: wrangling with pandas, exploration and visualisation, modelling and communicating results.

nodes.name: Data science workflow
nodes.desc: The iterative loop of asking a question, collecting and cleaning data, exploring, modelling and communicating.

nodes.name: Notebooks
nodes.desc: Working in Jupyter notebooks: cells, kernels, inline plots and keeping analysis readable.

nodes.name: NumPy arrays
nodes.desc: Vectorised computation with ndarrays: shapes, broadcasting, indexing and aggregation.

nodes.name: pandas DataFrames
nodes.desc: Series and DataFrames, selecting rows and columns, dtypes and basic summaries.

nodes.name: Getting data
nodes.desc: Loading data from CSV, JSON, Excel, web APIs and SQL databases into DataFrames.

nodes.name: Data cleaning
nodes.desc: Handling missing values, wrong types, duplicates, inconsistent categories and outliers.

nodes.name: Reshape & merge
nodes.desc: groupby and aggregation, pivot and melt, and joining tables on keys.

nodes.name: Time series data
nodes.desc: Datetime indexes, resampling, rolling windows and handling time zones.

nodes.name: Exploratory analysis
nodes.desc: Profiling a dataset: distributions, relationships, group comparisons and sanity checks.

nodes.name: Visualisation
nodes.desc: Plotting with matplotlib and seaborn and choosing the right chart for the question.

nodes.name: Feature engineering
nodes.desc: Encoding categories, scaling, binning, date parts and building informative derived features.

nodes.name: EDA report
nodes.desc: Clean and explore a messy public dataset and write up the main findings with charts.

nodes.name: scikit-learn models
nodes.desc: Fitting, validating and comparing models with scikit-learn pipelines and cross-validation.

nodes.name: A/B experiments
nodes.desc: Designing controlled experiments, choosing metrics and sample sizes, and reading the results.

nodes.name: Interpreting models
nodes.desc: Feature importance, partial dependence and SHAP values to explain what a model learned.

nodes.name: Prediction project
nodes.desc: Build, tune and explain a predictive model for a real dataset such as churn or prices.

nodes.name: Data storytelling
nodes.desc: Structuring an analysis as a narrative for a non-technical audience.

nodes.name: Dashboards
nodes.desc: Building interactive dashboards that track key metrics for stakeholders.

nodes.name: Reproducible analysis
nodes.desc: Version control, environments, parameterised notebooks and scripts others can rerun.

nodes.name: Data ethics
nodes.desc: Privacy, consent, bias in data and models, and responsible reporting.

nodes.name: Data science capstone
nodes.desc: An end-to-end project from question to data to model to a published, reproducible report.
